timing_method: Three counts, three repetitions; slope of median endpoint times. Native output allocation included; binary-file writing excluded. QDK QIR per-call overhead removed by slope. Native prototype versus public Python APIs.
isolation: Six headline hybrid cases were repeated after all other work stopped. Both QDK runs retained. Exploratory full sweep overlapped validation on another core; do not treat its timings as isolated headline measurements.
scope: QDK comparison only the matched surface-loss subset. Cultivation uses explicit parity ancilla and p=0.001; its added loss and original Pauli-channel semantics are Clifft-specific. Neutral-atom comparisons retain both five-level models.
sanitizer_scope: ASan, UBSan, and assertions on four representative cases. LeakSanitizer disabled because of sandbox ptrace restrictions.
integration: Standalone experimental executor; no public API or automatic routing changes.
